items.title: Leading AI models (even Grok) are all a bunch of leftist punks
items.raw_excerpt: Capitalism may be driving the AI boom, but the LLMs themselves have different economic and social views than many of the companies that built them. Leading AI models subjected to the Political Compass quiz overwhelmingly landed in the libertarian-left quadrant - even "MechaHitler," aka Grok, managed it in half its runs.

title_i18n.es: Los principales modelos de IA (incluso Grok) son todos una panda de punks izquierdistas.

excerpt_i18n.en: Capitalism may be driving the AI boom, but the LLMs themselves have different economic and social views than many of the companies that built them. Leading AI models subjected to the Political Compass quiz overwhelmingly landed in the libertarian-left quadrant - even "MechaHitler," aka Grok, managed it in half its runs.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 资本主义可能正在推动人工智能的繁荣，但大型语言模型本身的经济和社会观点与构建它们的许多公司并不相同。接受政治坐标测试的领先AI模型绝大多数
excerpt_i18n.es: El capitalismo puede estar impulsando el auge de la IA, pero los propios LLM tienen puntos de vista económicos y sociales diferentes a los de muchas de las empresas que los construyeron. Los principales modelos de IA sometidos al cuestionario Political Compass de forma abrumadora

items.title: Our toolchain assumes one human writer, AI agents break that illusion
items.raw_excerpt: Our tools assume one writer, and assume that writer is a human. Nothing computes what a change reads and writes at runtime, so the only known fix is brute force priced for organizations.

title_i18n.en: Our toolchain assumes one human writer, AI agents break that illusion
title_i18n.zh: 我们的工具链假设只有一位人类作者，AI 代理打破了这一假象。
title_i18n.es: Nuestra cadena de herramientas asume un escritor humano, los agentes de IA rompen esa ilusión.

excerpt_i18n.en: Our tools assume one writer, and assume that writer is a human. Nothing computes what a change reads and writes at runtime, so the only known fix is brute force priced for organizations.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我们的工具假定只有一个作者，且该作者是人类。没有任何机制能在运行时计算变更读取和写入的内容，因此已知的唯一解决办法是针对组织的暴力破解定价。
excerpt_i18n.es: Nuestras herramientas asumen un solo escritor, y asumen que ese escritor es humano. Nada calcula lo que un cambio lee y escribe en tiempo de ejecución, por lo que la única solución conocida es la fuerza bruta con precio para organizaciones.

items.title: Beyond RAG: Task-aware knowledge compression for enterprise AI on AWS
items.raw_excerpt: Traditional RAG hits a ceiling on analytical tasks that span hundreds of documents. This post shows how to use task-aware knowledge compression (TAKC) on AWS to pre-compress entire knowledge bases into task-specific representations, cache them at multiple fidelity tiers, and route each query to the right tier, with an open-source implementation you can deploy.

title_i18n.en: Beyond RAG: Task-aware knowledge compression for enterprise AI on AWS
title_i18n.zh: 超越RAG：AWS上企业AI的任务感知知识压缩
title_i18n.es: Más allá de RAG: Compresión de conocimiento consciente de la tarea para IA empresarial en AWS

excerpt_i18n.en: Traditional RAG hits a ceiling on analytical tasks that span hundreds of documents. This post shows how to use task-aware knowledge compression (TAKC) on AWS to pre-compress entire knowledge bases into task-specific representations, cache them at multiple fidelity tiers, and route each query to the right tier, with an open-source implementation you can deploy.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 传统RAG在涉及数百个文档的分析任务中遇到瓶颈。本文展示如何在AWS上使用任务感知知识压缩（TAKC）将整个知识库预压缩为任务特定的表征。
excerpt_i18n.es: El RAG tradicional encuentra un límite en tareas analíticas que abarcan cientos de documentos. Esta publicación muestra cómo usar la compresión de conocimiento consciente de la tarea (TAKC) en AWS para precomprimir bases de conocimiento completas en representaciones específicas de la tarea.
